name: gemma_7b
_source: google/gemma-7b official config.json (HuggingFace) - verified against multiple independent mirrors, all identical: hidden_size=3072, num_hidden_layers=28, num_attention_heads=16, num_key_value_heads=16 (standard multi-head attention, no GQA/MQA for this size), head_dim=256, intermediate_size=24576, vocab_size=256000.
_gemini_vs_gemma: This is Gemma, NOT Gemini - see gemma_2b.json for why Gemma (not Gemini) is used as the publicly-documented stand-in.
_scope: Same scope/omissions as gemma_2b.json - see that file's _scope note.
_notes: input.h=128 is the prompt length (seq_len) for this run - change it to model a different prefill length.

num_key_value_heads == num_attention_heads (16): Gemma 7B uses plain multi-head attention, unlike the 2B model's MQA - a real, published difference between the two sizes, not a simplification on our part.
